subject.title: RFC 0024: Localization Runtime and Product Coverage

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this cross-product localization direction, including a shared locale runtime, Gateway metadata contract, localized capability metadata, and a 21-locale coverage target?
rationale: The proposal deliberately creates product-wide contracts and governance obligations that cannot be safely selected by an automated documentation review.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded RFC
options.body: Approve the direction only after named owners narrow the v1 contract, compatibility commitments, and release-accountability model.

options.title: Defer to separate proposals
options.body: Keep this RFC draft while runtime, Gateway, plugin metadata, and documentation coverage decisions are independently sponsored and then consolidated.

options.title: Decline the shared-runtime direction
options.body: Retain surface-owned localization approaches and avoid creating a new cross-product core contract at this time.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded RFC
recommendation.body: Approve the direction only after named owners narrow the v1 contract, compatibility commitments, and release-accountability model.

likelyOwner.reason: No current-main ownership evidence was available in the readable review context for this cross-product decision.
